versions.changelog: Gate below-critical checkpoints on real state mutation, add explicit summary trigger flags for phase/goal changes and conflicts, document integration flags, and expand regression coverage
Harden warning-threshold summary writes, add atomic checkpoint/summary persistence, maintain latest-summary alias, and expand regression coverage after a second full rerun.
Fix critical-halt checkpoint persistence, refresh updated_at on durable writes, add .clawhubignore, and clarify the shipped test command in README.

Dual-thinking hardening: explicit schema/runtime field mapping, deterministic authority boundary, packaging checklist, stronger .clawhubignore, isolated tests without root pollution, explicit verification-evidence check.

Integration-learnings release: clarified weak-model-safe OpenClaw integration, documented thin-wrapper CLI patterns, stable latest-summary alias usage, and safe legacy-state detection before canonical initialization.

Hardening release: aligned the Python reference implementation with the SKILL contract, made host-provided pressure a first-class input, tightened halt behavior and bundle scope, improved weak-runtime guidance, and cleaned the publication surface.

Hardened runtime contract via 6-round dual-thinking review: deterministic startup/runtime completion, no token estimation, explicit host pressure dependency, consistent missing-summary handling, clearer weak-model execution flow.
Six-round dual-thinking refinement: deterministic runtime contract, first-run bootstrap, host-backed pressure fallbacks, explicit agent/developer split, and unconditional critical halt.
Initial release: durable task continuity, checkpoints, summaries, recovery, and safety gating.
